en.description:
Wristed packs 83 games into your Apple Watch. From classic arcade action to brain teasers and puzzle challenges, there's something for everyone.

15 CATEGORIES
Arcade Classics - Snake, Paddle Ball, Brick Break, Invaders
Action and Reflex - Tap Champ, Reaction Time, Whack Attack
Brain and Puzzle - Memory Match, Pattern Recall, Odd One Out
Learning - Math Quiz, Spell It, Flag Match
Motion - Jump Counter, Freeze Dance, Stair Climber
Creative - Finger Paint, Color Splash, Music Pad
Adventure - Mini Dungeon, Dragon Trainer, Spy Mission
Luck and Chance - Emoji Slots, Dice Roller, Fortune Cookie
Calm and Bedtime - Zen Pop, Breathing Balloon, Sheep Counter
Sports - Mini Hoops, Target Toss, Tap Soccer
Feelings and Friends - Mood Match, Kind Choice
Digital Crown - Spin Racer, Fishing Line
Collection - Creature Catcher, Feed Monster
Challenges - One Minute, Volcano Builder, Haptic Hunt
Utilities - Buzz Board, Flashlight, Strobe

FEATURES
Quest Mode: Create a hero and level up across games
No phone required: plays directly on Apple Watch
Works offline: play on planes, trails, anywhere
Designed for all ages
15 game categories with new games being added

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://wristedgames.com/privacy
en.subtitle: 80+ Arcade, Puzzle & Brain Fun
